title: b7z9.25.7: Python+Rust: add version-change hook to desync FSM RECOVERING state
description: Spec 02a.6.5 R-02a-087/088/089: when RPL DODAG version increments during RECOVERING, MUST reset consecutive_valid=0 and remain RECOVERING. Neither DesyncFSM has on_version_change(). Add method to both, wire from MultiRootState on_version_change() result.
